items.mainDefect: The Delete success path passes the object `name` instead of options.Kind as the kind label to recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: Delete sets the context with klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of the enriched `log`, so the name/kind/method values added by WithValues are lost.

items.mainDefect: The Create error path records a Storage failure with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: The Update error path also records a Storage failure with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

items.mainDefect: TestMode3_DeleteCollection never waits for or asserts the async Legacy.DeleteCollection call, so breaking the legacy path goes unnoticed.

secondary.defect: The DeleteCollection legacy goroutine records its result with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.

items.mainDefect: The async legacy goroutines derive their context from the request ctx, so the legacy operation is cancelled when the handler returns.

secondary.defect: The goroutine captures the same runtime.Object pointer that is used or returned elsewhere, which causes a data race; the object and options should be deep-copied first.
